subject: RE: FW: ZURICH AIRPORT - DXB / 230 CTN 2,572 KGS
body:
Hello,

Our buyer in Singapore is importing laboratory glassware from us in Germany, and I am arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote your fastest option for this import shipment to SIN (Singapore, SG)?

The goods will be ready for pickup at our site in 80075 (Munich), Germany, on 2026-11-26. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include it in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 7 pieces with a gross weight of 1001 kg and a total volume of 7.13 cbm. Please let me know the earliest possible arrival at SIN.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

Sent: 2026-09-12
Subject: ZURICH AIRPORT - DXB / 230 CTN 2,572 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex ZURICH AIRPORT to DXB:
